items.prompt: Before submitting, git status should show…
choices: No surprise junk or secrets you did not mean to ship
A detached HEAD forever with no commits
items.explain: Pre-submit status confirms you know what is tracked, ignored, or still local-only.

items.prompt: Course scripts should usually be run from…
choices: The repository root (where README and scripts/ live)
items.explain: Relative paths in scripts and Makefiles assume the repo root as cwd.

items.prompt: bash scripts/run_demo.sh 2>&1 | tee run.log saves command output for graders.
items.explain: tee duplicates stdout/stderr to a file while still showing it in the terminal.
Example env documents variables; real .env often holds secrets and stays local.
